explanation: Encodes Pommerenke's bound: for 0 ≤ r ≤ 1/2 the component containing 0 has diameter ≥ 2. The formalization uses the closed set {|f| ≤ 1}, whereas the page leaves implicit which set is meant. Closed is the natural choice: 0 lies in it since |f(0)| ≤ r^n, and an open-set component is contained in the corresponding closed one, so the closed version is the safer (weaker) reading.
